name: Nagawa (Aomori, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Nagawa town emblem in white: a ring with a small bar at the top, enclosing three vertical bars at the bottom.
history: Flag of the former town of Nagawa in Aomori Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-01.

features.role: Nagawa town emblem — a ring with a small bar at the top, enclosing three vertical bars at the bottom
